faq.q: Can I fix my roof myself?
faq.a: Roofs are dangerous, and improper repairs can make leaks worse. Many homeowners prefer a professional.

faq.q: How do I know if I need repair or replacement?
faq.a: Age, how widespread the damage is, and repair history all matter. An inspection gives the answer.
Flashing seals joints such as chimneys and vents. It is a common leak source when it fails.

services.name: Roof leak repair

headlines.text: Find where the water is really coming in

heroSub.text: {business} traces the leak to its source and repairs it, not just the stain.

services.blurb: Leaks traced to their true source and fixed, not just patched under the stain.
services.directAnswer: {business} repairs roof leaks across {areas}. Water often travels before it shows up inside, so the stain is rarely under the leak. We trace it to the source, explain it, and repair it. If you have active water intrusion, place a bucket, move belongings, and call {phone}.
process: Locate the entry point, not just the stain
Explain the cause and the repair
Repair and seal the leak source
Check for interior water damage and advise on next steps

faq.q: Why is the ceiling stain not under the leak?
faq.a: Water can travel along rafters or decking before dripping through. A roofer traces it back to the entry point.

faq.q: Can a leak wait until it stops raining?
faq.a: A small leak can become larger damage. Contain the water now and get it inspected soon.

faq.q: Should I tarp the roof myself?
faq.a: Climbing on a wet roof is dangerous. Many roofers can install a temporary cover.

faq.q: What should I do after a storm?
faq.a: Stay off the roof, photograph visible damage from the ground, cover interior water intrusion, and call a roofer and your insurer.

faq.q: Will insurance pay for roof damage?
faq.a: It depends on your policy and the cause. Your insurer decides.

faq.q: How soon should I get it fixed?
faq.a: Sooner is better, since water can cause more damage. Temporary covers can help until repairs are made.

faq.q: How often should a roof be maintained?
faq.a: At least once a year and after major storms is commonly recommended.

faq.q: Does maintenance extend a roof's life?
faq.a: Removing debris and fixing small problems early can help a roof last, though age and materials matter most.
Missing pieces, sagging, stains inside, and granules in gutters are common signs.
